comparison.objective: Insert and center a U-joint cross between opposed yoke bores; the candidate sets and locks an angular stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Overtravel, swing alignment, and bilateral bore insertion versus screw adjustment with wrench/driver countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Both journals are centered in their holes and still; candidate requires target angle, retained nuts, three cycles, low drift, and tool clearance.
comparison.reason: Both involve alignment, but the record tests constrained rigid insertion rather than torque-coupled calibration and retention.
